Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MRK.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 268 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2020.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.14 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 268 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 128 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
